s: A suffix attached to family names and other words identifying families or groups of people, to produce a female form, especially denoting a wife or mother.
Nachbar (“neighbour”) + -sche → die Nachbarsche (“the woman next door”, especially “the mother of the neighbour family”)
-sche.et: Feminine nomilisation of -sch. Compare Dutch -se, Low German -sche, -sch.
